title: Support Cohere v2 API
body:
### Feature Description

Cohere recently released [v2 of their API ](https://cohere.com/blog/new-api-v2), which includes support to define tools in JSON schema instead of Python types.

### Use Case

Supporting v2 enables complex tool definitions, which are now limited to primitive types, as mentioned in the docs https://sdk.vercel.ai/providers/ai-sdk-providers/cohere#model-capabilities. 

### Additional context

https://docs.cohere.com/v2/docs/migrating-v1-to-v2
